create_groupby_agg: create a group by aggregation that computes sum, mean, and count for each group in a DataFrame
create_groupby_head_tail: create a group by operation that retrieves the first and last n rows of each group
create_groupby_having: create a group by filter that selects groups matching predicate conditions after aggregation
create_rolling_groupby_agg: create a rolling window group by aggregation with time-based period and offset parameters
create_dynamic_groupby_agg: create a dynamic time-based group by aggregation with every, period, and offset intervals
